comparison.objective: Tamp coffee level and bayonet-lock the portafilter into a group head.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual support and pressing, followed by keyed insertion and rotational locking.
comparison.success_condition: Coffee depressed at least 6 mm while level, portafilter aligned and rotated into the lock range, then released.
comparison.reason: Rotational locking is generic overlap only; the record lacks fine tool insertion, moving-socket reacquisition, parameter tuning, and repeated dynamic response checks.
